newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse halts trading of CEU.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse halts trading of CEU.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) froze the share price and stopped trading of Central Escolar University when the issue fell by 560 pesos, or 40 percent, to 840 pesos in late trade on Monday.
The stock exchange automatically freezes the share price of an issue which rises by about 50 percent or falls by about 40 percent within a single trading day.
The bourse also stops trading until the company provides an explanation for the rise or fall of its share price.
The exchange said it has asked the CEU to explain why its share price has fallen by the limit.
